description: An 11-day early clinical experience program, dispersed over a five-week period, in which preclinical students in duos or trios worked in primary health care centers (Puskesmas) around Yogyakarta.
title: Eleven-day early clinical experience program in Indonesian primary health care centers (Puskesmas)

description: The article evaluates an 11-week intervention in \"instruction in phonological awareness\" provided in low-income, inner-city kindergarten classrooms by kindergarten teachers and their teaching assistants.
title: 11-week kindergarten phonological awareness intervention program
